"/"
  /conf → /conf
  /copy → /copy …
  /edit → /edit …
  /expose → /expose  (Expose a host loopback port to the sandbox.)
  /fork → /fork
  /grant → /grant …  (Grant temporary path access, spelled with the flags r, x, and w.)
  /grants → /grants  (List temporary pathname grants and port routes in either direction.)
  /help → /help
  /info → /info
  /job → /job …  (Inspect, stop, or discard a background job; prune drops every finished one.)
  /jobs → /jobs  (List the background jobs of this session.)
  /new → /new
  /open → /open …
  /revoke → /revoke …  (Revoke temporary pathname access or a port route.)
"/c"
  /conf → /conf
  /copy → /copy …
"/g"
  /grant → /grant …  (Grant temporary path access, spelled with the flags r, x, and w.)
  /grants → /grants  (List temporary pathname grants and port routes in either direction.)
"/grant "
  r → /grant r
  rw → /grant rw
  rx → /grant rx
  rxw → /grant rxw
"/r"
  /revoke → /revoke …  (Revoke temporary pathname access or a port route.)
"/revoke "
  /reference → /revoke /reference
  8080 → /revoke 8080
"/copy "
  agents-file → /copy agents-file
  config-dir → /copy config-dir
  config-file → /copy config-file
  home-dir → /copy home-dir
  last-message → /copy last-message
  scratch-dir → /copy scratch-dir
  session-chat → /copy session-chat
  session-chat-file → /copy session-chat-file
  session-dir → /copy session-dir
  session-id → /copy session-id
  session-log-file → /copy session-log-file
  session-name → /copy session-name
  skills-dir → /copy skills-dir
  snippets-dir → /copy snippets-dir
  system-prompt-file → /copy system-prompt-file
  workspace-dir → /copy workspace-dir
"/copy l"
  last-message → /copy last-message
"/copy sn"
  snippets-dir → /copy snippets-dir
"/edit "
  agents-file → /edit agents-file
  config-dir → /edit config-dir
  config-file → /edit config-file
  home-dir → /edit home-dir
  scratch-dir → /edit scratch-dir
  session-chat-file → /edit session-chat-file
  session-dir → /edit session-dir
  session-log-file → /edit session-log-file
  skills-dir → /edit skills-dir
  snippets-dir → /edit snippets-dir
  system-prompt-file → /edit system-prompt-file
  workspace-dir → /edit workspace-dir

  snippets-dir → /edit snippets-dir
"/open "
  agents-file → /open agents-file
  config-dir → /open config-dir
  config-file → /open config-file
  home-dir → /open home-dir
  scratch-dir → /open scratch-dir
  session-chat-file → /open session-chat-file
  session-dir → /open session-dir
  session-log-file → /open session-log-file
  skills-dir → /open skills-dir
  snippets-dir → /open snippets-dir
  system-prompt-file → /open system-prompt-file
  workspace-dir → /open workspace-dir
"/open sn"
  snippets-dir → /open snippets-dir
"//"
  //add → //add  (Add a task, then continue.)
  //ask → //ask  (Answer without making changes.)
  //help → //help
  //note → //note
"//a"
  //add → //add  (Add a task, then continue.)
  //ask → //ask  (Answer without making changes.)
"//h"
  //help → //help
